svg.title: Engineering pulse — real project commits
svg.desc: 956 commits across five public projects, 71 active days, peak 114 commits per day. 2026-08-21 through 2026-11-12 UTC. Each column represents one day; height is proportional to commit count. All authors, default branches, merge commits included. Snapshot 2026-11-12T08:14:58.386Z.
